department: Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering

deadline.value: Apply by noon CST on December 1 (2026) for Fall 2027.
deadline.quote: Fall Deadline December 1 | Applications for Fall admission must be received by noon (CST) on the deadline.

gre_subject.value: No subject GRE policy stated; this field has no GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: A faculty committee admits; advisors are matched after you meet all faculty in your first fall.
supervisor.quote: Individual faculty do not recommend admissions decisions and advisors are not determined at the time of application. Instead, students will match with advisors after meeting with all faculty during the fall semester.

funding.value: Admitted students are given RA, TA or fellowship support, subject to available funds and satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: Students admitted to the graduate program are provided financial support in the form of research assistantships, teaching assistantships, and fellowships.

entry_route.value: The department admits only to the PhD; a master's is not needed.
entry_route.quote: The MS degree is not a prerequisite for the PhD degree.
